title: Present with a bow with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- box body -->
  <rect x="20" y="42" width="60" height="45" rx="4" fill="#e8433f"/>
  <!-- lid -->
  <rect x="17" y="35" width="66" height="12" rx="3" fill="#ff6b65"/>
  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <rect x="20" y="37" width="58" height="5" rx="2" fill="#ff9b97"/>
  <!-- vertical ribbon on body -->
  <rect x="44" y="42" width="12" height="45" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- vertical ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x="44" y="35" width="12" height="12" fill="#ffe27a"/>
  <!-- ribbon shadow edge on body -->
  <rect x="53" y="42" width="3" height="45" fill="#e0a700"/>
  <!-- horizontal ribbon band across body -->
  <rect x="20" y="62" width="60" height="8" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <rect x="20" y="68" width="60" height="3" fill="#e0a700"/>
  <!-- bow loops -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="28" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#ffd23f" transform="rotate(-20 34 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="28" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#ffd23f" transform="rotate(20 66 28)"/>
  <!-- bow loop highlights -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="25" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#ffe27a" transform="rotate(-20 32 25)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="25" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#ffe27a" transform="rotate(20 68 25)"/>
  <!-- bow knot -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="31" rx="8" ry="7" fill="#ffb800"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="29" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#ffe27a"/>
  <!-- bow tails -->
  <path d="M42 36 Q36 44 30 46 L34 47 Q41 44 45 37 Z" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <path d="M58 36 Q64 44 70 46 L66 47 Q59 44 55 37 Z" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- smiley face on box -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="#3a2a00"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="#3a2a00"/>
  <circle cx="39.2" cy="50.8" r="1.2" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <circle cx="63.2" cy="50.8" r="1.2" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="58" r="3" fill="#ff8a85"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="58" r="3" fill="#ff8a85"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M40 58 Q50 68 60 58" stroke="#3a2a00" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- small sparkle -->
  <path d="M78 14 L80 20 L86 22 L80 24 L78 30 L76 24 L70 22 L76 20 Z" fill="#fff3b0"/>
</svg>
